resources.string: Here are the changes in this version. Your settings are preserved.
Smoother notification swipes: animated exit, gentle return for short gestures and animated row placement.
The hub label on home turns magenta when notifications are present.
Vertical battery icon with level and charging state, leaving more room for other indicators.
Smaller app symbol with more space inside circular icons.
This screen appears once after each update and can be reopened from About.
